{"path": "therm.py", "content": "import math
R_REF = 10000.0
T0 = 298.15      # 25 C in kelvin
B = 3950.0      # typical NTC B value

def to_celsius(adc_count, adc_max=1023):
    ratio = adc_count / (adc_max - adc_count)
    r = ratio * R_REF
    # Steinhart-Hart (beta form): 1/T = 1/T0 + (1/B)*ln(r/R0)
    inv_t = (1 / T0) + (1 / B) * math.log(r / R_REF)
    t_kelvin = 1 / inv_t
    return t_kelvin - 273.15
"}
